comment: The MySQL command-line client the desktop app bundles: mysql and mysqldump with the shared libraries they load, taken unmodified from Oracle's MySQL Community Server archives by scripts/fetch-mysql-client.py.

Verified on 2026-11-09 before the SHA-256 values were recorded: each archive's size matched cdn.mysql.com's Content-Length; its MD5 matched Oracle's published <archive>.md5 file on cdn.mysql.com; and gpg --verify accepted Oracle's detached <archive>.asc signature (VALIDSIG BCA43417C3B485DD128EC6D4B7B3B788A8D3785C, made 2026-10-01) with the MySQL Release Engineering key <mysql-build@oss.oracle.com> imported from the MySQL 8.4 manual (Signature Checking Using GnuPG), whose fingerprint matches the same key on keyserver.ubuntu.com. The SHA-256 values were computed only after those checks passed.

8.4.13 was the newest MySQL 8.4 LTS release on cdn.mysql.com for both archives on that date (HEAD requests: 8.4.12 and 8.4.14 return 404). To move to another release, repeat every check above and replace version, url, size, md5 and sha256 together.
